svg.title: Seedance 2.0 Skill OS
svg.desc: Editorial masthead: the wordmark Seedance 2.0 Skill OS above the line "Direct the model, don't micro-manage the frame", with a specification strip listing generation modes, the route-verify-direct-deliver pipeline, and supported reading languages.
